milestones.name: A GPU test in the sea, asset and cooker crates gets its device from one helper, and with no GPU it is skipped with a printed reason, or fails when a GPU is required
milestones.quality_bar: As dependable as wgpu's own `gpu_test` harness: one way to ask for a device, a skip that always says why, and no machine on which a missing GPU can pass for a run.

items.statement: `thrum-test-support` is registered in `.config/architecture.toml` as a dev-only crate: no package has it as a normal or build dependency, and the `dev-only-crates` rule refuses one.

A test asks for a GPU through one gate. With an adapter it runs. With none it prints a line that names the test and the reason and returns, and with `THRUM_REQUIRE_GPU=1` it fails. `./dev check` sets the variable on macOS, so on this Mac a missing adapter can never pass for a run.
items.ask: Read the gate and its tests. Is the no-adapter path exercised by a test that forces it, in both modes? Does `./dev check` set the variable on macOS and leave it unset elsewhere? Does the gate reach wgpu only, with no type of `thrum-render`'s in what it hands to a unit test inside `thrum-render`?

items.statement: Every GPU test and bench in `thrum-sea`, `thrum-asset-gpu` and `thrum-cook` takes its device through the gate: `device-request` is at zero for those crates, and their tests pass.
items.check: sh -c 'python3 scripts/shape_rules.py check --rule device-request --zero crates/thrum-sea crates/thrum-asset-gpu crates/thrum-cook && cargo test --locked --offline -p thrum-sea -p thrum-asset-gpu -p thrum-cook'

items.statement: The tests that ran in those crates before run now, and none that ran on this Mac is skipped.
items.ask: Compare the recorded test lists before and after for the three crates: was any test removed, renamed without a mapping, or reported as skipped on this Mac?

items.statement: Every registered exact baseline, on the Mac and in Chrome, passes the verifier at the claimed commit: this milestone moved no retained image.

milestones.name: Every GPU test in the engine goes through the gate, the graph tests that need no GPU run on every platform, and no test shares code by `#[path]`
milestones.quality_bar: As dependable as wgpu's own `gpu_test` harness, across the whole workspace: the same answer to 'does this test need a GPU' in every file, and a Linux or Windows run that neither fails for want of an adapter nor hides a CPU test.

items.statement: `device-request` is at zero across `crates/` and `examples/`: outside the device recipe and the gate, nothing asks wgpu for an adapter or a device.
items.check: python3 scripts/shape_rules.py check --rule device-request --zero crates examples

items.statement: No test file is gated as a whole on an operating system: `whole-file-gpu-gate` is at zero, the CPU-only graph validation tests build on every platform, and a Metal-only test is gated on the test, with its reason.
items.check: python3 scripts/shape_rules.py check --rule whole-file-gpu-gate --zero crates examples
items.ask: Do the 13 CPU-only tests the review named in `tests/graph_kinds.rs` now build with no macOS condition? Does any GPU test still return early without printing why?

items.statement: Test support shared inside a crate is a declared module: `path-attribute` is at zero under `crates/`.
The tests that ran before run now and pass on this Mac, and none that ran here is skipped.
items.ask: Compare the recorded `cargo test --workspace -- --list` output before and after: was any test removed, renamed without a mapping, or reported as skipped on this Mac?

items.statement: Every registered exact baseline, on the Mac and in Chrome, passes the verifier at the claimed commit: this milestone moved no retained image.
